_comment: The Hunspell dictionaries the desktop app ships for its spell checker on Windows and Linux (electron/spellcheck.cjs), pinned to the exact Electron release in package-lock.json: they come from that release's hunspell_dictionaries.zip, which scripts/fetch-spellcheck-dictionaries.mjs downloads at build time and checks against the sha256 recorded here (the zip, then every file taken out of it); the app checks the files again before it copies them into the profile. macOS uses the system spell checker and ships none of this. `node scripts/fetch-spellcheck-dictionaries.mjs --repin` rewrites this file for a new Electron release (after the 7-day cooldown of the dependency policy). Provenance: docs/security/spellcheck-dictionaries.md.
